interactive.label: min_photons
interactive.tooltip: Minimum photons per burst used when selecting bursts for the IRF/background estimate.

interactive.label: photon_window
interactive.tooltip: Number of consecutive photons required inside the time window to call a burst.

interactive.label: time_window
interactive.tooltip: Sliding time window in milliseconds used by the burst search.

interactive.label: quantile
interactive.tooltip: Quantile of the non-burst micro-time counts used as the background (dark-count) floor.

interactive.label: binning
interactive.tooltip: Micro-time binning factor applied before building the IRF histogram.

interactive.label: 🌙 Compute
interactive.tooltip: Extract the instrument response (IRF) and the per-detector background rates from the loaded files.

interactive.label: 🎯 Send to MLE
interactive.tooltip: Send the extracted IRF and background patterns to the burst-MLE lifetime fit.

interactive.label: Export MLE patterns
interactive.tooltip: Save per-detector IRF and background patterns in a NumPy archive for scripted MLE fitting.
